title: performance(canary): automated detection of latency/throughput regressions + rollout guards
author: Priya Shah
commits: feat(canary): add detection engine and threshold config
perf(runtime): add hysteresis guard to rollout controller
test(canary): add e2e canary simulation harness
docs(perf): operator guide for canary config
description: This PR adds automated detection for latency and throughput regressions to the performance canary system and introduces rollout guards and hysteresis to prevent unsafe traffic shifts. It implements a continuous perf sampling pipeline update to tag canary traffic, a detection engine that computes per-model baselines using EWMA and percentile windows and emits regression alerts when thresholds or z-score sensitivity is exceeded, and a rollout_guard controller that pauses or aborts traffic shifts when regressions are observed. The rollout guard supports configurable hysteresis windows, KV cache warmup grace periods, and automatic rollback policies. Added operator-facing YAML config fields, console preview for canary traffic shifts, metrics/tracing hooks for per-canary evaluation, unit + e2e simulation tests that model low-traffic and KV-warmup scenarios, and documentation for operators and SREs. Related linear tickets ENG-3245 and ENG-3301. Motivation: reduce user-facing tail-latency regressions caused by canary rollouts and make automatic detection actionable and conservative by default.
